application_periods.label: General
application_periods.notes: Apply before the August closing date; late applications considered on merit until 30 September. MBChB, BPharm and Radiography closed 30 June. No fee for South African applicants.

must_count: South African Sign Language Home Language
aps_rule.notes: Applicant Score (AS): sum of the percentages for six subjects, out of 600. Must include Home Language, First Additional Language and Mathematics/Maths Lit/Technical Maths. Life Orientation excluded. Quintile 1-3 schools add 7 with LO 50%+ (not modelled).

courses.name: Bachelor of Education in Senior Phase and FET Teaching - Commerce Stream
courses.notes: Campus: Gqeberha. To specialise in Accounting, Business Studies or Economics you need that subject at 60% in Gr 12. Choose two FET specialisations (Accounting, Business Studies, Economics, Mathematics, Maths Literacy) + one SP (EMS, Mathematics). To specialise in Maths Lit you must have taken Mathematics. Quintile 1-3 schools: +7 AS with LO 50%+.

courses.name: Bachelor of Education in Senior Phase and FET Teaching - Science Stream
courses.notes: Campus: Gqeberha. To specialise in Physical Sciences or Life Sciences you need that subject at 60% (Geography 55%). FET: Life Sciences, Physical Sciences, Geography, Mathematics or Maths Literacy; SP: Mathematics, Natural Sciences. Physical Science students must choose Mathematics as 2nd FET specialisation. Quintile 1-3 schools: +7 AS with LO 50%+.

courses.name: Bachelor of Education in Senior Phase and FET Teaching - Humanities Stream
courses.notes: Campus: Gqeberha. To specialise in a language, History or Geography you need that subject at 55%. FET: Afrikaans, English, isiXhosa, History, Geography; SP: languages, Social Science. If Geography is chosen, Maths 60% is required and Maths Lit/Tech Maths not accepted. Quintile 1-3 schools: +7 AS with LO 50%+.
